free_tier.stated: Free-model requests (model ids ending in:free) are capped by a table keyed on credits purchased all time, not on account age: 'Less than 10' credits gives 20 requests a minute and 50 requests a day; 'At least 10' credits gives 20 a minute and 1,000 a day. So the allowance with no credits purchased is 50 requests a day, and the 1,000-a-day ceiling requires purchasing credits; the page grants it starting one credit below the table threshold and prints that figure as an unrendered template placeholder. The page also notes 'Making additional accounts or API keys will not affect your rate limits, as we govern capacity globally'.

record.chaining: the fallback array is where this silently becomes a paid lane: a pipeline that lists a paid model as fallback bills for every request the free model refuses, which is why the free router (openrouter/free) is the only safe chain.

limits.value: 50 requests a day binds and it is a request count, not a token count: a 1,000-item job takes 20 days on the no-card lane, and the 20 rpm cap means the day's 50 requests are spent in under three minutes of traffic.

retention.stated: Keep your own copy of every file you upload.' Only model-created/promoted files are downloadable. Retention: indefinite.

egress.terms: Files API has 'no separate charge' and files 'do not expire'. But read-gated by design.

record.tooling: POST /api/v1/files (multipart), GET /api/v1/files, GET /api/v1/files/{id}/content. Global endpoint only (eu./us. return 403).
record.chaining: 10 GiB x unlimited workspaces is arithmetically a chain, but uploaded bytes cannot be downloaded again, so it is a write-only sink, not storage.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 100 MiB ('A larger file returns a 413 error'); 10 GiB per workspace; content-type sniffed from bytes and restricted to PDF/PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/MP3/WAV/FLAC/OGG/UTF-8 text. Arbitrary binaries are rejected at upload. Upload-open / read-gated: 'A request to GET /api/v1/files/{file_id}/content for an uploaded file returns a 400 error. Keep your own copy of every file you upload.' Only model-created/promoted files are downloadable. Retention: indefinite.
